hooks.command: sh -c 'root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; ver="$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require(process.argv[1]).version)" "$root/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" 2>/dev/null)"; for f in "$root/dist/red-fetch.mjs" "$root/../../dist/red-fetch.mjs"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { node "$f" dev "$ver" || true; node "$f" code-nav "$ver" || true; break; }; done; printf "{}"'
